scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke Elmshorn charging page explicitly publishes spontaneous charging without contract: AC up to 22 kW at EUR 0.59/kWh and DC at EUR 0.69/kWh. Ad-hoc activation is available by QR code/m8mit or SMS, with multiple payment methods including Mastercard, PayPal, Visa and direct debit. Contract tariffs are separately listed and not conflated with ad-hoc.

Current official e-mobility page explicitly distinguishes Adhoc Laden from the Stadtwerke Wedel card and publishes the direct price as EUR 0.59/kWh plus EUR 3.00 start fee. The page also confirms a public network of numerous stations and spontaneous charging as an alternative to charging cards.

Current official e-mobility page confirms the own public charging network and publishes SWB-Ladestrom prices from 01.02.2025: EUR 0.51/kWh AC and EUR 0.63/kWh DC, with a card setup fee and a monthly base fee for non-SWB electricity customers. Because the official numeric table is explicitly tied to the SWB-Ladestrom contractual card product and current station discovery confirms direct payment exists but does not expose a reliable numeric checkout price, the contract values are not promoted to ad-hoc.
this_pass.reason: official own-network contract tariff is current, but exact contract-free direct-payment price is not published; no extrapolation from the card tariff
